warm_up.name: Jumping Jacks
warm_up.form_tip: Keep a steady pace, land softly on the balls of your feet.

warm_up.name: Arm Circles
warm_up.form_tip: Start with small circles and gradually increase the size.

warm_up.name: High Knees
warm_up.form_tip: Drive your knees up to waist level, engage your core.

warm_up.name: Bodyweight Squats
warm_up.form_tip: Keep your chest up and push your hips back as if sitting in a chair.

warm_up.name: Dynamic Lunges
warm_up.form_tip: Step forward and drop your back knee straight down, keep torso upright.

warm_up.name: Torso Twists
warm_up.form_tip: Keep your hips facing forward and rotate from your upper spine.

cool_down.name: Standing Quad Stretch
cool_down.form_tip: Keep your knees together and push your hips slightly forward.

cool_down.name: Hamstring Stretch
cool_down.form_tip: Hinge at the hips, keep your back straight, don't round your shoulders.

cool_down.name: Shoulder Stretch
cool_down.form_tip: Pull your arm gently across your chest without twisting your torso.

cool_down.name: Deep Breathing
cool_down.form_tip: Inhale deeply through your nose for 4 seconds, exhale through your mouth for 6 seconds.

cool_down.name: Child's Pose
cool_down.form_tip: Sit back on your heels and reach your arms forward, relaxing your lower back.

chest.name: Push-Ups
chest.form_tip: Keep your core tight and elbows at a 45-degree angle.

chest.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
chest.form_tip: Keep feet flat on the floor and arch your back slightly.

chest.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
chest.form_tip: Set bench at 30-45 degrees for upper chest activation.

chest.name: Decline Push-Ups
chest.form_tip: Elevate your feet on a stable surface, keep body in a straight line.

chest.name: Chest Flyes
chest.form_tip: Keep a slight bend in elbows throughout the movement to protect the joint.

chest.name: Cable Crossovers
chest.form_tip: Squeeze your chest at the center and control the negative phase.

back.name: Pull-Ups / Assisted Pull-Ups
back.form_tip: Pull with your back, not your arms. Squeeze shoulder blades together.

back.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Rows
back.form_tip: Keep your back flat, almost parallel to the floor, and core engaged.

back.name: Lat Pulldowns
back.form_tip: Pull the bar to your upper chest, squeezing your lats. Avoid leaning too far back.

back.name: Seated Cable Rows
back.form_tip: Keep torso upright, squeeze shoulder blades at the end, do not use momentum.

back.name: Deadlifts
back.form_tip: Keep the bar close to your shins, hinge at hips, maintain a neutral spine.

back.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
back.form_tip: Support your non-working side on a bench, pull the dumbbell towards your hip.

shoulders.name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
shoulders.form_tip: Press straight up, don't flare elbows too wide. Keep core braced.

shoulders.name: Arnold Press
shoulders.form_tip: Rotate your palms forward as you press up, and backward as you lower the weight.

shoulders.name: Lateral Raises
shoulders.form_tip: Raise to shoulder height with a slight bend in elbows. Lead with your elbows.

shoulders.name: Front Raises
shoulders.form_tip: Alternate arms and control the movement on the way down.

shoulders.name: Face Pulls
shoulders.form_tip: Pull towards your face, externally rotating your shoulders. Focus on rear delts.

legs.name: Barbell Squats
legs.form_tip: Push through your heels, keep chest up and knees tracking over toes.

legs.name: Romanian Deadlifts
legs.form_tip: Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close to your legs, feel the stretch in your hamstrings.

legs.name: Bulgarian Split Squats
legs.form_tip: Keep your front foot far enough forward so your knee doesn't pass your toes.

legs.name: Leg Press
legs.form_tip: Don't lock out your knees at the top of the movement to maintain tension.

legs.name: Walking Lunges
legs.form_tip: Keep your torso upright and lower your back knee close to the floor.

legs.name: Calf Raises
legs.form_tip: Full range of motion — go all the way up on your toes and stretch down fully.

legs.name: Glute Bridges
legs.form_tip: Squeeze your glutes at the top and hold for a second. Drive through your heels.

arms.name: Barbell Bicep Curls
arms.form_tip: Keep elbows pinned to your sides, absolutely no swinging of the torso.

arms.name: Hammer Curls
arms.form_tip: Keep palms facing each other throughout the movement. Targets the brachialis.

arms.name: Preacher Curls
arms.form_tip: Keep your armpits snug against the pad, control the weight on the way down.

arms.name: Tricep Dips
arms.form_tip: Keep your body upright to focus on the triceps, lean forward to hit the chest.

arms.name: Tricep Pushdowns
arms.form_tip: Keep upper arms completely stationary, squeeze the triceps hard at the bottom.

arms.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
arms.form_tip: Keep your elbows pointing towards the ceiling and close to your head.

core.name: Plank
core.form_tip: Keep your body in a perfectly straight line from head to heels. Don't let hips sag.

core.name: Bicycle Crunches
core.form_tip: Twist from your torso, trying to touch your shoulder (not just elbow) to your knee.

core.name: Hanging Leg Raises
core.form_tip: Control the movement entirely with your abs, avoid swinging your body.

core.name: Russian Twists
core.form_tip: Keep your feet off the ground and lean back slightly. Follow the weight with your eyes.

core.name: Dead Bugs
core.form_tip: Crucial: Press your lower back flat into the floor throughout the entire movement.

core.name: Ab Wheel Rollouts
core.form_tip: Keep your core braced and don't let your lower back arch as you roll out.

cardio.name: Treadmill Intervals
cardio.form_tip: Increase speed gradually, maintain good posture and pump your arms.

cardio.name: Jump Rope
cardio.form_tip: Stay light on the balls of your feet with a very slight knee bend.

cardio.name: Burpees
cardio.form_tip: Full extension at the top with a jump, chest touches the floor at the bottom.

cardio.name: Mountain Climbers
cardio.form_tip: Keep hips low, hands under shoulders, and drive knees to chest rapidly.

cardio.name: Rowing Machine
cardio.form_tip: Power comes from the legs first (push), then lean back, then pull with arms.

cardio.name: Stairmaster
cardio.form_tip: Step through your whole foot, try not to lean heavily on the handrails.

flexibility.name: Yoga Sun Salutations
flexibility.form_tip: Move seamlessly with your breath — inhale to extend, exhale to fold.

flexibility.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
flexibility.form_tip: Kneeling position, push hips forward gently, keep torso completely upright.

flexibility.name: Pigeon Pose
flexibility.form_tip: Keep your hips square to the ground and ease slowly into the stretch.

flexibility.name: Foam Rolling (Full Body)
flexibility.form_tip: Roll slowly (1 inch per second), pausing on tight spots or 'knots' for 20-30 seconds.

flexibility.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
flexibility.form_tip: Inhale as you arch your back and look up, exhale as you round your spine and tuck your chin.
